item.title: Two Lotteries: What It Takes to Make Sparsity Fast
item.author: amir.g@ucf.edu (Amir Ghazizadeh)
item.description: Suppose you remove 80% of a neural network’s weights and recover its original accuracy. You might reasonably expect it to run much faster. Then you put it on a GPU, and the improvement is small. Sometimes it runs slower.
